prompt_fragment: This asset is a background or texture. Prioritize atmosphere and surface coherence over a single isolated subject.
raw_description:
A subdued cartographic map of Aurora Berg, rendered as an archival chart
on warm-cream parchment. The Aurora Stack crystalline spire colony
sketched on one tier of the Berg, Nightshelf tunnel labyrinths
crosshatched beneath, the Corpse Current marked as a dark arc of warm
water tracking below the sea-ice. Compass rose in one corner. Faint
hex-grid overlaying the landmass. Echo-script annotations in the margins.
Muted enough that white text overlaid on it stays fully legible — this
is a backdrop, not a feature. Antique atlas aesthetic, civilizationally
aware.
formatted_prompt: Editorial ink-and-watercolor field-journal illustration on aged warm-cream parchment (#F5EDD8), rendered as an antique atlas chart in 16:9 landscape. A subdued cartographic spread of a great polar iceberg-continent fills the frame: one elevated tier sketched with slender crystalline spires and prismatic lens towers in pale ice-blue (#4A90C5) linework, representing the sunlit vertical colony — tiered ceremonial halls, coronet arches, faint aurora-green shimmer traced along polished surfaces. Beneath, crosshatched tunnel labyrinths in warm brown (#6B5548) suggest underground passages. A dark arc of deep ocean blue (#1E4A85) curves below the sea-ice margin, annotated as a warm-water current. Faint hex-grid overlays the landmass in translucent ochre (#C18A63). A decorative compass rose occupies one corner in fine nib-pen linework. Chinese-influenced echo-script annotations crowd the parchment margins. Tonal values kept deliberately low-contrast and muted — soft washes, restrained saturation — so white overlay text reads cleanly against the surface. Foxed parchment edges, aged paper grain, civilizationally aware cartographic calm.
